title: teucrium wightii
intro: Teucrium wightii, commonly known as Nilgiri Eucalyptus, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Teucrium wightii include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Teucrium wightii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
